verdict.summary: The game bundle consumes V3/cartes/<slug>.png, not the icon or halo sources. Once the parent has integrated the revisions and regenerated all final print PNGs, build_game_bundle.cjs overwrites the site's card PNG/WebP derivatives and data.js. Direct race/effect/art images are loaded from V3/assets. No application V2 asset cache or migration route was found. Browser HTTP cache must still be revalidated.
verdict.visual_limit: The two isolated browser scripts replace images with a 1x1 PNG. Their success validates behavior and DB contracts, NOT the new artwork, alpha, framing, halo pixels, image requests or final exports.

findings.title: Final print exports must precede the game bundle
findings.detail: build_game_bundle.cjs reads V3/cartes, validates 897x1497, crops at (50,50) to 797x1388, writes -full.png and a 538px-wide WebP, and separately produces -art.webp. It does not execute Photoshop or incorporate new race/weapon/crystal/halo PNGs itself. Building while exports are incomplete can show a new direct race icon beside an old baked card image.

evidence.note: Canonical illustration, weapon and race paths
Canonical halo source baked into print

findings.freshness_caveat: mtime is an advisory freshness check, not pixel proof. Parent is exporting concurrently; this count can change immediately.

findings.title: Bundle success and exported count are not freshness proofs
findings.detail: A missing print is skipped and reported but does not cause a nonzero exit; an older derivative may remain. game-bundle.json records counts and crop only, not source hashes or the harmonisation revision. All required paths currently exist, so this is a build-validation gap rather than a missing-file failure in this snapshot.
findings.recommendation: After final exports, require 41/41, missing=[], and verify source freshness plus visible changes on representative cards.

findings.title: Direct UI symbols and baked print symbols have different paths
findings.detail: Race logos in detail are direct ../assets/races/<RACE>.png. Weapon 11 appears in baked cards; detail/filter text remains Instrument. NONE.png is placed in print cards, while filter/version selector/duel status intentionally use a circle-slash symbol. PNG halos MINERO/GEO are baked around attack values; moving board auras and spell trails are procedural canvas drawings and will not change when a PNG is replaced.

evidence.note: Race image and weapon text in detail
Print uses uppercase element PNG including NONE

findings.recommendation: Validate these surfaces separately; do not interpret unchanged procedural effects or circle-slash controls as stale V2 copies.

findings.title: Integration hash guard omits the actual DB module
findings.detail: integrate_harmonisation.cjs lists site/db.js, but production uses site/local-db.js. The nonexistent db.js is silently skipped. The existing guard therefore proves cartes/elements/regles/engine stability, not historical local-db.js stability. This audit additionally hashes the actual DB/UI/stat files and executes isolated DB tests. No relevant source changed during this audit.

evidence.note: site/db.js path in optional contract list

findings.recommendation: For future integration gates, check local-db.js, armes.json, regles_demo.json and identity registries as well. No code changed in this audit.

findings.title: Stable URLs require reload, not DB reset
findings.detail: No service worker, CacheStorage asset cache, V2 runtime asset path or revision-folder runtime route was found in top-level site source. URLs are not content-hashed, so an HTTP browser cache or an already-open page can still display earlier bytes. Revalidate/reload after the parent's bundle. Preserve the same origin and do not clear localStorage or IndexedDB to refresh graphics.

evidence.note: data.js is loaded by its stable filename

legacy_data_notes.legacy_registry: V3/donnees/registre_identifiants.json contains 20 legacy 000000xx entries, but neither the active site nor the scripts reference it. Current identity authority is cartes.json and registre_personnages.json; the latter passes 41-card/40-character tests.

This helper was not run and is not called by the game bundle.
